summary: Iter 76 verification — Backend 6/6 pytest passes, /auth/me returns all extended profile fields. Frontend: discovered + fixed CRITICAL bug (missing EditProfilePage import in App.js caused entire app to render blank). After fix, verified sidebar email removal + profile-link → /profile/edit, /profile/edit page renders all 11 testids and Save shows 'Profile updated' toast, Commissioner Settings tab-divisions label is 'League Structure'. SetupWizard dialog opens correctly with Skip button, help icons, Roster/Bench/Minors inputs (visually confirmed via screenshot) but the dialog closed in a subsequent automated re-open attempt before testid query — visual evidence is sufficient to confirm all required wizard UI elements exist.

ui_bugs.issue: EditProfilePage was used at route /profile/edit but never imported → 'EditProfilePage is not defined' ReferenceError crashed the entire React app, rendering blank screen on every route. FIXED by adding 'import EditProfilePage from "@/pages/EditProfilePage";' on line 16.

action_items: Verify SetupWizard PremiumTrialBanner countdown behavior end-to-end (cap-enable toggle within wizard reveals banner) — visually confirmed all underlying UI exists, but automated state-toggle assertions on the dialog were flaky in headless Playwright (dialog appears to remount after reopen). Main agent can verify by manual click-through in the wizard.
critical_code_review_comments: MISSING IMPORT BUG (FIXED): App.js used <EditProfilePage /> without importing it. This is the kind of regression that should be caught by lint/type-check before merge. Recommend running 'yarn build' or eslint with 'no-undef' in CI for App.js.

Wizard re-open flakiness: clicking [data-testid=health-reopen-wizard-btn] a second time in the same session may immediately re-close the wizard. Worth investigating focus/open-state management on the dialog component.
